title: Design lines and turning radius cues
summary: This topic mixes exterior design-line impressions, HUD or camera line displays, and comments about turning radius, with limited clearly labeled sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive feedback praises the overall exterior design lines for retaining a classic 5-series look.

negative.summary: Negative feedback says the HUD map line display is not helpful.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined examples mention design lines, missing backing or parking radius lines, door-panel line irregularities, and improved turning radius without enough context to confirm sentiment labeling.

limitations: The topic cluster mixes unrelated subjects including exterior styling lines, display guidance lines, panel-fit lines, and turning radius.
Most examples are labeled undetermined, so the available evidence for clear sentiment is limited.
The sample is small and stratified, so it should not be treated as representative of all G60 feedback on this topic.
